name: deployment-celld
title: celld: your own machines, a Durable Object per chat
description: Runs a pikit project of the durable target on your own machines with celld (self-hosted Durable Objects): the Worker and its objects, wrangler.jsonc, the commands `pikit up | down | logs | status | dev` delegate to, a CI deploy script, and the nodes' templates.

environment.name: CELLD_BUCKET
environment.description: The fleet's bucket, as the nodes are given it: s3://name (AWS S3, R2, Tigris), gs://name or az://container, with an optional /prefix. It needs conditional writes (not Hetzner, DigitalOcean Spaces or Backblaze B2). `pikit up` deploys to it; `pikit dev` does not need it.

environment.name: PIKIT_CELLD_URL
environment.description: The fleet's public URL (https://bot.example.com, behind Caddy or a load balancer): `pikit up` waits for /health there and gives it to the components' afterDeploy hooks (the Telegram webhook).

environment.name: S3_ENDPOINT
environment.description: The bucket's S3-compatible endpoint, when it is not AWS S3 (R2: https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com). Stays on this machine.

environment.name: AWS_REGION
environment.description: The bucket's region (R2: auto; default us-east-1). Stays on this machine.

environment.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environment.description: A key of the bucket, for `celld deploy` and a rollback (R2: an S3 API token). It stays on this machine: the Worker never gets it.

environment.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environment.description: The secret of AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID. It stays on this machine: the Worker never gets it.

environment.name: PIKIT_CELLD_SSH
environment.description: Optional: the nodes' SSH destinations, separated by commas (deploy@10.0.0.11,deploy@10.0.0.12), for `pikit logs` (journalctl) and `pikit down` (systemctl stop, one node at a time).
